name: Greenhouse Bed Range
description: A bulk planting entry: this range of beds, this variety, this protocol. Expanded into Individual Beds on save — new bed numbers only, so a bed's later replanting/uprooting history is never overwritten by re-saving the range it started from.

fields.label: Variety Yield
fields.description: Expected stems/plant for this range, if known. Not derived — an agronomist's number, same as Crop Protocol's own yield fields.

fields.label: Plants Per Sqm
fields.description: Density for this range. Used to fill in each bed's plant count when expanded.

fields.label: Total Beds Area
fields.description: (To Bed - From Bed + 1) x Bed Length x Bed Width.

fields.label: Crop Cycle
fields.description: Set automatically when this range was synced in from a Crop Cycle. Blank for a range typed directly here.

fields.label: Applied
fields.description: Set once this range has added its beds to Individual Beds. Never reprocessed after that -- a bed it covers may since have been replanted to something else via a log, and re-checking this row against that would conflict with its own history.
